-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def etcdstart.xsOf (ps : List w64) (idx : w64 → srvApi.KVSNames) : w64 → GName :=
  (idx ((List.find? (fun id => decide (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)) = p)) ps).getD 0)).slog

theorem etcdstart.xsOf_at (ps : List w64) (idx : w64 → srvApi.KVSNames) (hnd : (idPfxsOf ps).Nodup)
    (id : w64) (hid : id ∈ ps) : etcdstart.xsOf ps idx (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id))) = (idx id).slog

theorem etcdstart.ΦsOf_at [v3rpc_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions]
    (ps : List w64) (idx : w64 → srvApi.KVSNames) (hnd : (idPfxsOf ps).Nodup) (id : w64) (hid : id ∈
    ps) : etcdstart.ΦsOf ps idx (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id))) = srvFloorFacts (idx id).slog

theorem etcdstart.memberStartRes_split [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (n p : GoString) (c : Option
    GoString) : etcdstart.memberStartRes n { peer := some p, client := c } ⊢ httpProtoFree p ∗ ∀ γn,
    http.httpProtoOwn p (raftProto (netRh γn)) -∗ etcdstart.memberFreshRes n { peer := some p,
    client := c } γn

theorem etcdstart.allocN [v3rpc_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions]
    (hne : mvcc.api.names_nonempty.law) (ids ps : List w64) (hperm : ps.Perm ids) (id0 : w64) (hid0
    : id0 ∈ ids) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (boot : List LogEntry) (Hbc : BootCore ps ctxs boot) (dir :
    w64 → List GoString) (ms : List (GoString × GoString × Option GoString)) (Hd0 : dir 0 = [])
    (Hhost : ∀ (i : w64) (h : GoString), go!"http://" ++ h ∈ dir i → h ∈ List.map (fun x =>
    x.snd.fst) ms) (Hrb : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2) (Hrb2 : receiptBound GF + boot.length ≤ 2 ^
    61) (lm : lease.Mode) (hrun : lease.runCfg lm lm) (hap : lm = lease.Mode.revocable →
    leaseIdsApart ids) (cmp : Bool := false) (cret : Nat := 0) : ⊢ bootMarshal ps ctxs
    (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) -∗ ([∗list] m ∈ ms, etcdstart.memberStartRes m.fst { peer := some
    m.snd.fst, client := m.snd.snd }) ={⊤}=∗ ∃ γ γk Φs γn gs, ⌜γ.vs = ps ∧ γ.rule = srvRule (W64 0)
    (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) ∧ γ.boot = LogEntry.toEntries boot 0 ∧ γn.N = srvNet γ ∧ γn.dir =
    dir ∧ List.map (fun x => x.id) gs = ids ∧ (∀ (g : etcdstart.MemberG GF), g ∈ gs →
    etcdstart.memberGOk γ γk g) ∧ γk.c0 = W64 0 ∧ γk.ch0 = apply.alarmChain false false false ∧
    γk.log0 = [[], []] ∧ γk.cmp = cmp ∧ γk.cret = cret⌝ ∗ (□ ∀ lid, netHttpOk γn lid) ∗ ([∗list] g ∈
    gs, etcdstart.memberBoot g.γ ctxs g.ρ g.E Φs g.id cmp lm) ∗ ([∗list] m ∈ ms,
    etcdstart.memberFreshRes m.fst { peer := some m.snd.fst, client := m.snd.snd } γn) ∗ if decide
    (lm ≠ lease.Mode.none) = true then True else etcdKV γk (kvModelSt γk (bootEntries
    (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0)))

def etcdstart.ΦsOf (ps : List w64) (idx : w64 → srvApi.KVSNames) : w64 → w64 → List w8 → GName →
    IProp GF :=
  srvFloorFacts (idx ((List.find? (fun id => decide (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)) = p)) ps).getD 0)).slog

theorem etcdstart.memberBoots_of [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (γ : SrvRaft) (ps : List w64) (ctxs
    : List (List w8)) (issued cnt wn fs : GName) (γk : KVNames) (Φs : w64 → w64 → List w8 → GName →
    IProp GF) (γm : mvcc.api.MvccName) (idx : w64 → srvApi.KVSNames) (cok rev reg xs : w64 → GName)
    (Hiss : γk.ids.issued = issued) (Hwn : γk.ids.wn = wn) (Hfs : γk.ids.fs = fs) (Hc0 : γk.c0 = W64
    0) (Hch : γk.ch0 = apply.alarmChain false false false) (Hlog : γk.log0 = [[], []]) (Hvs : γ.vs =
    ps) (cmp : Bool) (Hkc : γk.cmp = cmp) (lm : lease.Mode) (hrun : lease.runCfg lm lm) (Hklg :
    γk.lm = lm) (hpo : kvPfxOk γk) (L : List w64) (hpfx : ∀ (id : w64), id ∈ L → lm =
    lease.Mode.revocable → idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)) ∈ γk.gps) (HΦ : ∀ (id : w64), id ∈ L → Φs
    (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id))) = srvFloorFacts (idx id).slog) (Hx : ∀ (id : w64), id ∈ L → xs
    (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id))) = (idx id).slog) : ⊢ srvRaftLogInv { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 :=
    W64 0 } -∗ idClusterInv issued cnt wn fs srvFloorFacts -∗ W64 0 ↪[issued]□ none -∗ srvPropMint {
    raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } γk.ids -∗ srvRdCtxInv { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0
    } issued -∗ kvInv { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } γk -∗ ([∗list] id ∈ L, iprop((idPfxOf
    (W16 (uint.Z id)), 0) ↪[cnt] ([], none) ∗ idKeyFactAt fs (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)), 0) (xs
    (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)))) ∗ (nodeBoot γ.cl srvClusterN ps ctxs id ∗ raftState γ.cl id
    RaftState.init ∗ nodeVacant γ.cl id) ∗ ∃ γd, ⌜γ.snapLoc id = some γd⌝ ∗ ghostMapAuth γd 1 ∅)) -∗
    ([∗list] id ∈ L, idWaitTokAt wn (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)), 0)) -∗ ([∗list] id ∈ L,
    iprop(srvApi.newServerStoreFreshA (idx id) ∗ ghostMapAuth (cok id) 1 ∅ ∗ ghostMapAuth (rev id) 1
    ∅ ∗ ghostMapAuth (reg id) 1 ∅)) ==∗ ∃ gs, ⌜List.map (fun x => x.id) gs = L ∧ ∀ (g :
    etcdstart.MemberG GF), g ∈ gs → etcdstart.memberGOk γ γk g⌝ ∗ [∗list] g ∈ gs,
    etcdstart.memberBoot g.γ ctxs g.ρ g.E Φs g.id cmp lm

def etcdstart.memberGOk (γ : SrvRaft) (γk : KVNames) (g : etcdstart.MemberG GF) : Prop :=
  (∃ r,
      g.γ =
        { cl := γ.cl, vs := γ.vs, rule := γ.rule, boot := γ.boot, reg := r, snapLoc := γ.snapLoc, log := γ.log,
          fresh := γ.fresh, props := γ.props, fired := γ.fired, rdFresh := γ.rdFresh, pend := γ.pend,
          authOn := γ.authOn }) ∧
    g.ρ.rd.kv.st = γk.st ∧ g.ρ.rd.kv.c0 = γk.c0 ∧ g.ρ.rd.kv.ch0 = γk.ch0 ∧ g.ρ.rd.kv.log0 = γk.log0 ∧ kvSame g.ρ.rd.kv γk

theorem etcdstart.newServerNames_allocL [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (ps : List w64) (hnd : ps.Nodup) : ⊢
    |==> ∃ idx cok rev reg, [∗list] id ∈ ps, iprop(srvApi.newServerStoreFreshA (idx id) ∗
    ghostMapAuth (cok id) 1 ∅ ∗ ghostMapAuth (rev id) 1 ∅ ∗ ghostMapAuth (reg id) 1 ∅)

theorem etcdstart.netHttp_reserveL [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (γn : NetNames GF) (As : List
    GoString) (hd0 : γn.dir 0 = []) (hhost : ∀ (i : w64) (h : GoString), go!"http://" ++ h ∈ γn.dir
    i → h ∈ As) : ⊢ inv streamRegN iprop(∃ m, ghostMapAuth γn.reg 1 m) -∗ ([∗list] a ∈ As,
    httpProtoFree a) ==∗ (□ ∀ lid, netHttpOk γn lid) ∗ [∗list] a ∈ As, http.httpProtoOwn a
    (raftProto (netRh γn))

theorem etcdstart.find_pfx (ps : List w64) (hnd : (idPfxsOf ps).Nodup) (id : w64) (hid : id ∈ ps) :
    List.find? (fun id' => decide (idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id')) = idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)))) ps =
    some id
